title: Soot’s luck
html_source: Chimney sweeps are associated with luck in Britain, though this usage is more sarcastic than direct.

anchor.prefix:
should I see dodging along Stony Batter only Joe Hynes. 

 — Lo, Joe, says I. How are you blowing? Did you see that bloody chimneysweep near shove my eye out with his brush? 

 —
anchor.suffix:
, says Joe. Who's the old ballocks you were talking to? 

 — Old Troy, says I, was in the force. I'm on two minds not to give that fellow in charge for obstructing the thoroughfare
